name: Retro Comic Book & Pop Art
description: Vintage Roy Lichtenstein pop art, bold black ink outlines, Ben-Day halftone dots, saturated primary colors.
system_instructions: Illustrate as a vintage 1960s pop art comic book panel. Bold black ink linework, visible colored Ben-Day halftone dot printing pattern, dynamic action angles, saturated CMYK primary palette (cadmium red, cobalt blue, bright yellow), paper texture grain.
